purpose: Cymek hands trained Core subjects to Triquetra for causal cognition research. Triquetra never guesses architecture, tokenizer, lineage, or training amount; Cymek never trains against Triquetra's diagnostics without a preregistered treatment.
direction: Cymek -> Triquetra: CoreSubjectManifest + checkpoint custody + tokenizer identity + task-scoring adapter contract. Triquetra -> Cymek: InternalizationTarget (causal receipt -> training intervention).

subject_manifest.validator_mirror: v5_registry.subject.triquetra_validation reproduces triquetra x_factor/manifest_validator.py REQUIRED_FIELDS verbatim
subject_manifest.rule: fail closed on missing or placeholder identity fields

evaluation.firewall: VisibleTask/EvaluatorTruth split enforced structurally; gold joins only after output commit
evaluation.causality: evaluation uses the canonical packed-layout causal mask; adversarially tested against future-token leakage

expected_return_object.name: InternalizationTarget
expected_return_object.note: Triquetra returns this after causal diagnosis; Cymek converts it into a preregistered ExperimentSpec via v5_experiments and matched arms.

current_registered_subjects: see artifacts/cymek/registry/entries/ (all SOFTWARE_* canary subjects with custody 'local-ephemeral-checkpoint-store'; no scientific checkpoint has been produced)
import_rule: Triquetra imports the canonical runtime interfaces (adapter, manifest, protocol); it does not copy Cymek training code.
